title: ascm pull request draft frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of .github/PULL_REQUEST_DRAFT.md. It carries the metadata the PR script passes to gh pr create and gh pr edit. The title is the draft's level-one heading and the description is its body, so neither appears here. Every field is optional.

base.description: The branch the pull request targets, and the branch the script diffs against to collect the commits' LLM trailers.

draft.description: Open the pull request as a draft.

labels.description: Labels that already exist in the repository. A label name has no comma, since gh splits on commas, and no leading or trailing space.

reviewers.description: Requested reviewers: a GitHub login, or org/team for a team.

assignees.description: Assignees: a GitHub login, or @me for the person running the script.

milestone.description: The name of an existing milestone.
